1.name: app
1.description: Runtime entrypoints and application lifecycle orchestration modules.

1.1.name: app.base
1.1.description: Executable base runtime entrypoint that initializes config, logging, test orchestration, and the main app lifecycle.

1.1.2.name: app.base.execute
1.1.2.description: Execute app lifecycle and return process exit code.

1.1.3.name: app.base.run
1.1.3.description: Run the app with explicit config/logger initialization, tracked execution, and integrated testing.

2.name: config
2.description: Layered JSON configuration and dependency declarations.

2.1.name: config.base.json
2.1.description: Base runtime configuration covering COMMON placeholder values, logging, input loading, processing, and output artifacts.

2.3.name: config.requirements.txt
2.3.description: Python dependency manifest for the runtime and tooling stack.

3.name: scripts
3.description: Automation scripts for instantiation and base update pulls.

3.1.name: scripts.instantiate
3.1.description: Instantiate BaseApp into a target path using manifest-driven copy rules and initial app customization.

3.1.1.name: scripts.instantiate.load_manifest_entries
3.1.1.description: Load entries from all manifests in docs/manifests grouped by behavior key.

3.1.2.name: scripts.instantiate.instantiate
3.1.2.description: Instantiate BaseApp into target_root with manifest-driven file copying.

3.1.3.name: scripts.instantiate.main
3.1.3.description: CLI entrypoint for instantiating a new app variant.

3.2.name: scripts.pullbase
3.2.description: Pull base updates from a BaseApp source into an instantiated app using manifest-driven or hard-copy behavior.

3.2.1.name: scripts.pullbase.hard_pull
3.2.1.description: Copy every non-excluded file from source_root into local_root, overwriting local files.

3.2.2.name: scripts.pullbase.pull_base_files
3.2.2.description: Copy files and folders listed in manifest pull entries from source into the local app.

3.2.3.name: scripts.pullbase.main
3.2.3.description: CLI entrypoint for applying base updates to an instantiated app.

4.1.name: docs.manifests

4.3.name: docs.readme

4.4.name: docs.message_codes

4.5.name: docs.templates

4.5.1.name: docs.templates.html_table
4.5.1.description: Default HTML template for rendering tables with optional titles and captions.

4.6.name: docs.version
4.6.description: Base and app version marker files that track release state across pulls and instantiation.

4.6.1.name: docs.version.base
4.6.1.description: Base version record that should be updated with each pull of base updates.

4.7.name: docs.architecture

4.7.1.name: docs.architecture.base
4.7.1.description: Structured base feature inventory for the reusable architecture.

4.7.2.name: docs.architecture.app
4.7.2.description: Structured variant-layer feature inventory for app-owned architecture.

5.1.1.description: Base testing configuration that defines settings, phases, checks, and output artifacts.

5.2.1.2.name: test.config.base.live

6.name: utils
6.description: Reusable runtime, conversion, loading, and testing utilities.

6.1.name: utils.baseutils
6.1.description: Core runtime utility module that provides configuration composition, HTML rendering, logging, output persistence, and the Main lifecycle.

6.1.1.name: utils.baseutils.trackit
6.1.1.description: Track function execution and return result with extensible metrics.

6.1.2.name: utils.baseutils.dict_merge
6.1.2.description: Recursively merge override dict into base dict and return the merged result.

6.1.3.name: utils.baseutils.Params
6.1.3.description: Simple container that exposes dictionary values as attributes and supports deep merge, evaluation, and placeholder population.

6.1.4.name: utils.baseutils.Config
6.1.4.description: Load, merge, evaluate, and populate runtime configuration.

6.1.5.name: utils.baseutils.resolve_dotted
6.1.5.description: Resolve object, Params, and dict values by dotted path syntax.

6.1.6.name: utils.baseutils.HtmlDoc
6.1.6.description: Render DataFrame, dict, and list datasets into HTML documents via template files.

6.1.7.name: utils.baseutils.load_message_lookup
6.1.7.description: Load and concatenate message dictionary CSV files, deduplicating by code.

6.1.8.name: utils.baseutils.create_logger
6.1.8.description: Create a logger instance using configured paths, verbosity, and message dictionaries.

6.1.9.name: utils.baseutils.Logger
6.1.9.description: Simple logger that stores messages, emits console output, persists CSV and HTML logs, and publishes a runtime data map.

6.1.9.18.name: utils.baseutils.Logger.log
6.1.9.18.description: Store a message or data payload with the current timestamp.

6.1.9.18.1.name: utils.baseutils.Logger.log.resolve_message
6.1.9.18.1.description: Resolve message text and type from the message code lookup.

6.1.9.18.2.name: utils.baseutils.Logger.log.store_data
6.1.9.18.2.description: Store normalized data payload in the logger state map.

6.1.9.18.3.name: utils.baseutils.Logger.log.store_message
6.1.9.18.3.description: Append the resolved log event to the in-memory event list.

6.1.9.18.4.name: utils.baseutils.Logger.log.print_to_console
6.1.9.18.4.description: Print the formatted log event to the console when verbosity allows it.

6.1.10.name: utils.baseutils.save
6.1.10.description: Save data to JSON, CSV, or HTML outputs using runtime-aware serialization rules.

6.1.11.name: utils.baseutils.AppManager
6.1.11.description: Main runtime lifecycle class that loads inputs, processes data, stores outputs, and finalizes run state.

6.1.11.1.name: utils.baseutils.AppManager.load_data
6.1.11.1.description: Load all enabled config.input entries into results targets; persists per-input last_modified maps in self.input_meta to support DataLoader delta mode across cycles.

6.1.11.2.name: utils.baseutils.AppManager.process_data
6.1.11.2.description: Run configured processing steps against loaded results data.

6.1.11.3.name: utils.baseutils.AppManager.store_outputs
6.1.11.3.description: Persist configured outputs, including split artifacts and JSON materialization diagnostics.

6.1.11.4.name: utils.baseutils.AppManager.close
6.1.11.4.description: Finalize the run state and prepare runtime artifacts for saving.

6.1.11.5.name: utils.baseutils.AppManager.run
6.1.11.5.description: Run the full data loading and processing pipeline, then store outputs.

6.2.name: utils.datautils
6.2.description: Data conversion and file loading utilities used by the runtime pipeline.

6.2.1.name: utils.datautils.DataFrameConverter
6.2.1.description: Securely applies transformation rules to a pandas DataFrame.

6.2.2.name: utils.datautils.DataLoader
6.2.2.description: Load files from a source file or folder using configurable format and optional logging. Supports an input-level `delta` flag: in delta mode the loader rescans the source on every call and only loads files that are new or whose on-disk mtime changed since the previous load, tracking per-file mtimes in last_modified.

6.3.name: utils.testutils
6.3.description: Testing framework utilities for prep, live, and post runtime validation.

6.3.1.name: utils.testutils.TestManager
6.3.1.description: Coordinate config-driven prep, live, and post runtime tests.

6.3.2.name: utils.testutils.build_test_config
6.3.2.description: Build runtime test configuration by combining integrated app config with the testing base config.

6.3.3.name: utils.testutils.evaluate_checks
6.3.3.description: Evaluate declarative checks and return structured pass or fail results.

6.3.4.name: utils.testutils.monitor_activity
6.3.4.description: Validate that runtime monitoring produced the expected amount of activity.
